"""One authorized same-version source-build preparation, separate from inference."""
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
from urllib.parse import urlsplit

META = dict(artifact_status='experimental_unvalidated', operator_approved=False,
            formal_gate_status='not_run_not_passed')
CHANNEL = 'https://conda.anaconda.org/conda-forge'
ATTEMPT = 's0_cpu_prepare_r3a'
BUILD_ENV = 'bio_build_glibc217_r2'
ARCHIVE_SHA = '731b17a23514bf2460083d4585a42d5ece4137643960c354469790857af52735'
SOURCES = {
    'numexpr': dict(version='2.14.1', filename='numexpr-2.14.1.tar.gz',
        url='https://files.pythonhosted.org/packages/cb/2f/fdba158c9dbe5caca9c3eca3eaffffb251f2fb8674bf8e2d0aed5f38d319/numexpr-2.14.1.tar.gz',
        bytes=119400, sha256='4be00b1086c7b7a5c32e31558122b7b80243fe098579b170967da83f3152b48b'),
    'connected-components-3d': dict(version='4.1.1', filename='connected_components_3d-4.1.1.tar.gz',
        url='https://files.pythonhosted.org/packages/23/66/62eeb4d29188a1161289c58c9129294856ce0f134fb9b49c3d13ae0db1d1/connected_components_3d-4.1.1.tar.gz',
        bytes=85178, sha256='becc200f0b9fd8c16ffe0ddb37c94a963737b96b79705c8ae25dd141f402f990'),
    'ndindex': dict(version='1.10.1', filename='ndindex-1.10.1.tar.gz',
        url='https://files.pythonhosted.org/packages/f5/92/4b9d2f4e0f3eabcfc7b02b48261f6e5ad36a3e2c1bbdcc4e3b7b6c768fa6/ndindex-1.10.1.tar.gz',
        bytes=271395, sha256='0f6113c1f031248f8818cbee1aa92aa3c9472b7701debcce9fddebcd2f610f11'),
}


def require(ok, message):
    if not ok:
        raise RuntimeError(message)


def sha(path):
    h = hashlib.sha256()
    with Path(path).open('rb') as stream:
        for block in iter(lambda: stream.read(1024**2), b''):
            h.update(block)
    return h.hexdigest()


def write(path, payload):
    path = Path(path)
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with path.open('x') as stream:
        json.dump(dict(META, **payload), stream, indent=2, sort_keys=True, allow_nan=False)
        stream.write('\n')
    path.chmod(0o440)


def prior_guard(root):
    root = Path(root)
    result = {}
    for name in ('bio_intel_py310', 'bio_intel_py310_r2', 'bio_intel_py310_r3'):
        prefix = root / 'envs' / name
        require(prefix.is_dir(), 'old environment absent: ' + name)
        result[name] = {str(p.relative_to(prefix)): sha(p)
                        for p in sorted((prefix / 'conda-meta').glob('*')) if p.is_file()}
        result[name]['bin/python'] = sha(prefix / 'bin/python')
    markers = ('operator/ENV_INSTALL_FAILED.json', 'operator/environment_r2/FAILED.json',
               'operator/environment_r3/FAILED.json', 'operator/environment_r4_preflight/FAILED.json',
               'operator/environment_r4_official_preflight_r2/FAILED.json',
               'operator/asset_materialization/FAILED.json')
    result['failures'] = {name: sha(root / name) for name in markers}
    return result


def validate_build_plan(plan):
    require(plan.get('success') is True, 'build environment solver failed')
    selected = plan['actions']['LINK']
    require(len({x['name'] for x in selected}) == len(selected), 'duplicate build packages')
    versions = {x['name']: x['version'] for x in selected}
    for name, value in {'python': '3.10.22', 'numpy': '2.2.6', 'sysroot_linux-64': '2.17'}.items():
        require(versions.get(name) == value, 'build version drift: ' + name)
    for name in ('gcc_linux-64', 'gxx_linux-64', 'binutils_linux-64', 'setuptools', 'wheel', 'cython', 'pip', 'tomli', 'packaging'):
        require(name in versions, 'build tool missing: ' + name)
    require(versions['gcc_linux-64'].split('.')[0] == versions['gxx_linux-64'].split('.')[0] == '13',
            'compiler generation drift')
    for item in [*selected, *plan['actions'].get('FETCH', [])]:
        require(item['name'] not in ('torch', 'pytorch', 'torchvision', 'pytorch-cuda'), 'model dependency in build env')
        require(item.get('platform', item.get('subdir')) in ('linux-64', 'noarch'), 'build platform drift')
        urls = [item.get(k) for k in ('url', 'base_url', 'channel')
                if isinstance(item.get(k), str) and '://' in item[k]]
        require(urls, 'absolute build package origin missing')
        for url in urls:
            parsed = urlsplit(url)
            require(parsed.scheme == 'https' and parsed.netloc == 'conda.anaconda.org'
                    and (parsed.path == '/conda-forge' or parsed.path.startswith('/conda-forge/'))
                    and not parsed.query and not parsed.fragment, 'build package origin drift')
    return selected


def parent_staging_guard(root):
    parent=Path(root)/'attempts/s0_cpu_prepare_r1'
    require(sha(parent/'reports/STAGING_FAILED.json')=='be077b174c4975aa0ee7daa26dfd562816d726f0c71be433f19fcf0c54960ee6',
            'parent CPU staging failure SHA drift')
    return {str(p.relative_to(parent)):sha(p) for p in sorted(parent.rglob('*')) if p.is_file()}

def parent_r2_guard(root):
    parent=Path(root)/'attempts/s0_cpu_prepare_r2'
    require(sha(parent/'contract/PREPARATION_CONTRACT.json')=='8a2246326f58d7351712785e2395c54fb81949ad7a4390f19e18e80980329980', 'parent R2 contract drift')
    require(sha(parent/'slurm/prepare.slurm')=='d879a1addf9756b3bfa8561b96e33f600deb87c1b14f9483e79217d8506620ff', 'parent R2 Slurm drift')
    require(sha(parent/'operator/submit_usage_r2/SUBMISSION_RECEIPT.json')=='592c93f24b50993446ff38210c5e0ef352a554beb7c0c3dea147b41ee4f71eda', 'parent R2 receipt drift')
    paths=[p for p in sorted(parent.rglob('*')) if p.is_file()]
    require(len(paths)<100 and all(p.stat().st_size<1024**2 for p in paths), 'parent R2 light identity budget')
    return {str(p.relative_to(parent)):sha(p) for p in paths}

def r3_evidence_guard(attempt, contract):
    for relative,key in [('contract/USER_AUTHORIZATION.json','user_authorization_sha256'),
                         ('contract/BOOTSTRAP_VERIFICATION.json','bootstrap_verification_sha256'),
                         ('contract/BUILD_ENV_EXPLICIT.txt','build_env_explicit_sha256'),
                         ('reports/SOURCE_BUILD_REQUIREMENTS.json','source_build_requirements_sha256')]:
        require(sha(Path(attempt)/relative)==contract[key], 'R3 evidence drift: '+relative)

def failed_r3_guard(root):
    parent=Path(root)/'attempts/s0_cpu_prepare_r3'
    expected={
      'contract/BOOTSTRAP_VERIFICATION.json':'7ce1cdac2c4bda31ea96e2fa41d14662818fe9e27003b416bced4ea91a08c146',
      'contract/BUILD_ENV_EXPLICIT.txt':'866d02c7106d809d4f14b87c0da101e2c3c722ab50f7a8f78e3ea89fb5fc2d77',
      'contract/USER_AUTHORIZATION.json':'f31dae05deb4003a8f3d23cbcad6ddfed044a7c7e3f32a4cfc966e821474aa8c',
      'operator/SUBMISSION_FAILED.json':'48af2f4f423d66ff8c8a8d2158f52842028a05de1a0b6e08b8b9f3df50c77127'}
    actual={str(p.relative_to(parent)):sha(p) for p in parent.rglob('*') if p.is_file()}
    require(actual==expected,'failed R3 partial inventory drift')
    failed=json.loads((parent/'operator/SUBMISSION_FAILED.json').read_text())
    require(failed['job_id'] is None and failed['stage']=='freeze_R3_package','failed R3 may have a job')
    return actual

def recovery_parent(root):
    path=Path(root)/'attempts/s0_cpu_prepare_r3a'
    require(sha(path/'reports/FAILED.json')=='8a5d33b7f6900d27c8f9c282c82b08cd373330ca3dcb2f321a1520a53c4c4432','original CPU failure drift')
    require(sha(path/'contract/PREPARATION_CONTRACT.json')=='6615846dca72b6b0cd2dd861cfa8e656ae9e2c9f51ffbb952f566fc62481063c','parent R3a contract drift')
    require(sha(path/'slurm/prepare.slurm')=='cc76d642f087be1b5b83d3b7208ffb152ca256e303071017f7f7ee66438795d5','parent R3a Slurm drift')
    require(sha(path/'reports/WHEELS_COMPLETE.json')=='79b288745b7912cdd3b4ddebe4782ee4b8a66d96c8fd159bec6a0440394eb6d5','original wheels manifest drift')
    contract=json.loads((path/'contract/PREPARATION_CONTRACT.json').read_text())
    for relative,digest in contract['package_files'].items():require(sha(path/relative)==digest,'parent R3a frozen runtime drift')
    wheels=json.loads((path/'reports/WHEELS_COMPLETE.json').read_text())['wheels']
    require(len(wheels)==3,'three reused wheels required')
    for item in wheels:
        wheel=Path(item['path'])
        require(wheel.is_relative_to(path/'wheels') and not wheel.is_symlink() and wheel.is_file(),'reused wheel path boundary')
        require(wheel.stat().st_size==item['bytes'] and sha(wheel)==item['sha256'],'reused wheel bytes/SHA drift')
    return contract,wheels

def recovery_guard(attempt,contract):
    root=Path(contract['remote_root'])
    require(Path(attempt)==root/'attempts/s0_sif_recovery_r2' and contract['attempt']==str(attempt),'recovery attempt drift')
    require(contract['resource']==dict(partition='cpu_192G',cpus_per_task=8,memory_gib=64,time_limit='04:00:00',gpu=0),'recovery resource drift')
    require(contract['maximum_normalized_layer_bytes']==16*1024**3 and contract['incremental_budget_bytes']==150*1024**3,'recovery storage budget drift')
    require(contract['single_conversion_deadline_seconds']==7200 and not contract['automatic_retry'],'recovery timing policy drift')
    require(prior_guard(root)==contract['prior_guard'],'prior environment/failure drift')
    require(parent_staging_guard(root)==contract['parent_attempt_files'],'R1 staging drift')
    require(parent_r2_guard(root)==contract['parent_R2_attempt_files'],'R2 attempt drift')
    require(failed_r3_guard(root)==contract['failed_R3_attempt_files'],'failed R3 inventory drift')
    _,wheels=recovery_parent(root)
    require(wheels==contract['reused_wheels'],'reused wheel manifest changed')
    for relative,key in [('contract/USER_AUTHORIZATION.json','user_authorization_sha256'),
                         ('contract/COMPATIBILITY_VERIFICATION.json','compatibility_verification_sha256')]:
        require(sha(Path(attempt)/relative)==contract[key],'recovery evidence drift')
    require(failed_sif_r1_guard(root)==contract['failed_SIF_R1_guard'],'failed SIF R1 changed')
    proof=json.loads((Path(attempt)/'contract/COMPATIBILITY_VERIFICATION.json').read_text())
    remote_python310_guard(root,proof)
    remote_proof=root/'operator/sif_hardlink_compatibility_r1/COMPLETE.json'
    require(sha(remote_proof)==proof['remote_complete_sha256'],'real minimal compatibility proof drift')
    require(proof['normalizer_source_sha256']==contract['package_files']['runtime/normalize_oci_hardlinks.py'],'normalizer not the tested version')
    for relative,digest in contract['package_files'].items():require(sha(Path(attempt)/relative)==digest,'recovery package drift')
    for relative,digest in contract['build_env_files'].items():require(sha(Path(contract['build_env'])/relative)==digest,'accepted build env drift')
    require(Path(contract['build_env']).name=='bio_build_glibc217_r2','recovery build env identity')


def failed_sif_r1_guard(root):
    parent=Path(root)/'attempts/s0_sif_recovery_r1'
    expected={
        'contract/PREPARATION_CONTRACT.json':'d957f9e1240186436b7e8ecb607a0f47ef52e7be2b1303cd384959bffe428784',
        'slurm/prepare.slurm':'4368622f008a106baf159dde2842723f4b387d24bcd208b1b4ad5285779df60b',
        'reports/FAILED.json':'526085de8e5a3209ab43cd38cce22826aad54e1ea5a89f4a8fe338da79ad2e9d'}
    for name,digest in expected.items():require(sha(parent/name)==digest,'failed SIF R1 identity drift: '+name)
    contract=json.loads((parent/'contract/PREPARATION_CONTRACT.json').read_text())
    for name,digest in contract['package_files'].items():require(sha(parent/name)==digest,'failed SIF R1 package drift')
    failure=json.loads((parent/'reports/FAILED.json').read_text())
    require(failure['job_id']=='4304987' and failure['status']=='S0_SIF_recovery_failed','failed SIF R1 marker identity')
    require(not (parent/'reports/COMPLETE.json').exists(),'failed SIF R1 COMPLETE conflict')
    return dict(expected,package_files=contract['package_files'])

def remote_python310_guard(root,proof):
    reference=proof['python310_verification']
    path=Path(root)/'operator/sif_empty_layer_verification_r2/COMPLETE.json'
    require(path.is_file() and path.stat().st_size<131072 and sha(path)==reference['remote_complete_sha256'],'same-Python verification missing or drift')
    result=json.loads(path.read_text())
    require(result['status']=='same_remote_Python310_empty_layer_and_small_native_probe_pass_not_full_SIF_or_GPU_pass','same-Python verification status')
    require(result['python_major_minor']==[3,10] and result['all_eight_checks_pass'] and len(result['checks'])==8,'same-Python checks incomplete')
    require(result['original_empty_errno22_reproduced'] and result['small_same_backend_native_probe_pass'],'empty/native compatibility incomplete')
    require(result['candidate_source_sha256']==reference['candidate_source_sha256']==proof['normalizer_source_sha256'],'tested candidate source drift')
    require(result['original_source_sha256']==proof['original_normalizer_source_sha256']=='8c8ba3ac4daad96a4f6a8fe043757e4d102f7e913a0a2a88ec28960005258205','original normalizer identity drift')
    require(result['failed_recovery_sha256']=='526085de8e5a3209ab43cd38cce22826aad54e1ea5a89f4a8fe338da79ad2e9d','tested prior failure drift')
    require(all(result[name] is False for name in ('models_loaded','images_read','jobs_created','full_image_conversion_attempted','packages_installed')),'verification scope drift')
    return result


import os, re, shutil, subprocess
from datetime import datetime, timezone
root=Path(os.environ['EXTERNAL_MET_REMOTE_ROOT'])
attempt=root/'attempts/s0_sif_recovery_r2'
receipt_path=attempt/'operator/SUBMISSION_RECEIPT.json'
receipt=json.loads(receipt_path.read_text())
require(receipt['status']=='CPU_preparation_job_released_not_artifact_or_model_runtime_pass','CPU submission not accepted')
job_id=receipt['job_id']
require(job_id=='4309579','recovery JobID drift')
require(re.fullmatch(r'[0-9]+',job_id),'CPU JobID invalid')
queries={
    'queue':['squeue','-h','-j',job_id,'-o','%i|%T|%P|%j|%r'],
    'accounting':['sacct','-P','-j',job_id,'--format=JobID,JobName,State,ExitCode,Elapsed,Start,End'],
    'job':['scontrol','show','job',job_id,'-o'],
    'quota':['quota','-s'],
}
scheduler={}
for name,argv in queries.items():
    p=subprocess.run(argv,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=30)
    require(len(p.stdout.encode())+len(p.stderr.encode())<65536,'CPU observation metadata budget')
    scheduler[name]=dict(returncode=p.returncode,stdout=p.stdout,stderr=p.stderr)
contract=json.loads((attempt/'contract/PREPARATION_CONTRACT.json').read_text())
drift=[]
identities={**contract['package_files'],
    'contract/PREPARATION_CONTRACT.json':receipt['contract_sha256'],
    'slurm/prepare.slurm':receipt['slurm_sha256']}
static={}
for name,digest in identities.items():
    path=attempt/name
    observed=sha(path) if path.is_file() else None
    static[name]=dict(expected_sha256=digest,observed_sha256=observed)
    if observed!=digest:drift.append(name)
if parent_staging_guard(root)!=contract['parent_attempt_files']:drift.append('parent_CPU_staging')
if prior_guard(root)!=contract['prior_guard']:drift.append('prior_environment_or_failure')
reports={}
for path in sorted((attempt/'reports').glob('*.json')):
    if path.name=='NORMALIZATION_COMPLETE.json':
        reports[path.name]=dict(bytes=path.stat().st_size,sha256=sha(path),content_not_transferred=True)
        continue
    require(path.stat().st_size<65536,'CPU report too large for light observation')
    reports[path.name]=dict(bytes=path.stat().st_size,sha256=sha(path),content=json.loads(path.read_text()))
logs={}
for path in sorted((attempt/'logs').glob('*')):
    if not path.is_file():continue
    with path.open('rb') as stream:
        stream.seek(max(0,path.stat().st_size-16384))
        tail=stream.read(16384).decode(errors='replace')
    logs[path.name]=dict(bytes=path.stat().st_size,tail=tail,tail_only=True)
    require(len(logs)<=12,'CPU log count budget')
recovery_guard(attempt,contract)
artifact_identity={}
if 'COMPLETE.json' in reports:
    complete=reports['COMPLETE.json']['content']
    require(complete['job_id']==job_id,'CPU completion JobID drift')
    require(complete['status']=='S0_recovery_artifacts_complete_runtime_and_GPU_still_require_validation','CPU completion status drift')
    require('FAILED.json' not in reports,'CPU COMPLETE conflicts with FAILED')
    require(sha(attempt/'reports/WHEELS_REUSED.json')==complete['reused_wheels_sha256'],'reused wheels report drift')
    require(sha(attempt/'reports/NORMALIZATION_COMPLETE.json')==complete['sif']['normalization_report_sha256'],'normalization ledger drift')
    for item in [complete['sif'],*contract['reused_wheels']]:
        path=Path(item['path'])
        observed=sha(path) if path.is_file() and not path.is_symlink() else None
        valid=path.is_file() and path.stat().st_size==item['bytes'] and observed==item['sha256']
        artifact_identity[str(path)]=dict(expected_bytes=item['bytes'],observed_bytes=path.stat().st_size if path.is_file() else None,
            expected_sha256=item['sha256'],observed_sha256=observed,valid=valid)
        if not valid:drift.append(str(path))
result=dict(META,status='read_only_SIF_recovery_observation_not_inference_pass',job_id=job_id,
    scheduler=scheduler,reports=reports,logs=logs,static_identity=static,drift=drift,
    artifact_identity=artifact_identity,submission_receipt_sha256=sha(receipt_path),
    free_bytes=shutil.disk_usage(root).free,remote_utc=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
    remote_writes=False,solver_rerun=False,jobs_created=False,models_loaded=False,images_read=False)
print(json.dumps(result))


source_root=root/'assets/bio_source'
identity_path=root/'operator/BIO_SOURCE_IDENTITY.json'
require(identity_path.stat().st_size<262144,'author identity metadata budget')
identity=json.loads(identity_path.read_text())
require(identity['commit']=='83c73e0cac0b5a3c77a298547040ea3ea7f99854','author revision drift')
source_files={}
interfaces={}
for name,item in identity['files'].items():
    path=source_root/name
    require(path.resolve().is_relative_to(source_root.resolve()),'author source path escape')
    require(sha(path)==item['sha256'],'author source identity drift: '+name)
    source_files[name]=dict(bytes=path.stat().st_size,sha256=item['sha256'])
    if path.name=='requirements.txt' or any(word in path.name.lower() for word in ('predict','inference','install_trainers')):
        require(path.stat().st_size<65536,'author interface per-file budget')
        interfaces[name]=path.read_text()
require(sum(len(v.encode()) for v in interfaces.values())<196608,'author interface total budget')
versions_code="import importlib.metadata as m,json; out={};\nfor n in ['torch','torchvision','pandas','numpy','numexpr','connected-components-3d','ndindex','nnunetv2','monai','SimpleITK','nibabel','scipy','timm','einops','threadpoolctl','matplotlib','pillow']:\n try: out[n]=m.version(n)\n except m.PackageNotFoundError: out[n]=None\nprint(json.dumps(out))"
old_environment=root/'envs/bio_intel_py310_r3'
p=subprocess.run([str(old_environment/'bin/python'),'-B','-c',versions_code],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=40)
require(p.returncode==0,'R3 installed-package inventory failed')
require(len(p.stdout)<16384,'environment metadata budget')
installed=json.loads(p.stdout)
assets_path=root/'operator/ASSETS_MATERIALIZED.json'
assets_metadata=None
if assets_path.is_file():
    require(assets_path.stat().st_size<262144,'asset manifest metadata budget')
    assets_metadata=json.loads(assets_path.read_text())
readiness=dict(META,status='read_only_inference_readiness_not_submission',preparation=result,
    author_identity_sha256=sha(identity_path),author_revision=identity['commit'],author_files=source_files,
    environment_R3_versions=installed,environment_R4_exists=(root/'envs/bio_intel_py310_r4').exists(),
    environment_R4_audit_exists=(root/'operator/environment_r4').exists(),
    asset_metadata=assets_metadata,root_inventory=[p.name for p in sorted(root.iterdir())],
    remote_utc=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),remote_writes=False,jobs_created=False,
    models_loaded=False,images_read=False,author_interface_text_not_publication_evidence=True)
print(json.dumps(dict(metadata=readiness,author_interfaces=interfaces)))
